name: month_offset
description: Compute month after an offset; control copies an unrelated tag in matched calendar text.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
m='January February March April May June July August September October November December'.split();a=[];c=[]
for i in range(120):
 x=random.randrange(12);n=random.randrange(1,13);tag=random.choice(['amber','blue','green','red']);s=f'Event tag: {tag}. The current month is {m[x]}. '
 a.append({'prompt':s+f'What month is {n} months later? Answer:','answer':' '+m[(x+n)%12]})
 c.append({'prompt':s+f'An event occurs {n} months later. What is its tag? Answer:','answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':a,'control':c},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
